name: EPIC 211516807
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 14.9 solar radii and 1.67 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211516807 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 14.894129 (16th-84th percentiles 14.115042-16.224189), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 8,925 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.67 solar masses and 14.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,902 K at its surface.
